mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following a GDPC1 value above 18000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following a FEDFUNDS value below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicates the Fed is managing inflation without aggressive tightening, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following a CPIAUCSL value above 250 and FEDFUNDS below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates sustained labor market strength that drives consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following a UNRATE value below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 110) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following an INDPRO value above 110.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255) indicates rising cost pressures that erode corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following a CPIAUCSL value above 255.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) and declining unemployment (UNRATE decline > 0.1%) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 5-day periods following a PAYEMS growth rate above 0.5% and UNRATE decline exceeding 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1100) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, a leading indicator of economic activity that supports corporate profitability and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 60-day periods following a HOUST value above 1100.
